audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[].side reads 'Skill' on every row while content.win[] and the packet levelChart give Tahm Kench levels 1-3, even levels 4-5 through first item, and Renata at 2+ items.
audit.why: Renata is a fragile, poke-less enchanter early, so Tahm Kench walks her down before Handshake (Q) is a threat; her AoE Hostile Takeover (R) and Bailout (W) start out-utility-ing a single-target peel once teams group.
audit.corrected: phases[0,1,2,6].side moved to match win[] and the packet chart; matching why text rewritten. phases[3,4,5] already match win[3,4,5]='Skill' and are left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Renata's root/bind ability 'E Loyal to a Fault' or just 'E bind' — the kit shows the root is Handshake (Q, hardCC flag), while E (Loyalty Program) only slows and shields with no CC flag. This is a wrong-ability-slot error, not a naming typo, and it appears in whys[3], spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, early, mid, and wants.foe[0].
audit.why: enemyKit.abilities lists Q Handshake with flags.hardCC ('lockdown — check tenacity, cleanse and QSS') while E Loyalty Program carries no hardCC flag — the root/throw is unambiguously the Q, not the E.
audit.corrected: All six occurrences rewritten to credit Handshake (Q) with the root and Loyalty Program (E) with the slow/shield, matching the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real number, and the missingInteractions entry (Bailout's sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing) isn't reflected in the text.
audit.why: Hostile Takeover (R) is 150/130/110s and Bailout (W) is 28/27/26/25/24s and heals through chip damage, so anti-heal timing decides extended trades against it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with Hostile Takeover's cooldown and a Bailout anti-heal note.

edits.before: - Renata Glasc Hostile Takeover: matchup-defining — The berserk wave turns your team on itself — never group in a line against it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Devour (ally save) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
